description: List the payment rails Demo Store really accepts (e.g. stripe, x402), with the instruments available per rail (card, apple_pay, usdc_base, ...). Derived from the merchant's live connection state — call this BEFORE checkout to negotiate a rail the agent can settle.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency of the cart (e.g. EUR). Only effective_methods is evaluated for it; accepted_rails never changes.

tool.description: Optional checkout tool the methods are evaluated for. Default complete_checkout.

name: get_payment_methods
